Every firehouse is its own career — and each due position (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th) is its own track. Master your 1st due, expand into your 2nd, learn your 3rd and 4th. Difficulty (TRAINING → EXPERT) is your own choice in Settings — it never changes your rank, and your rank never locks it.

      About this data

      Running order. Who runs each box, in the order the Fire Department sends each kind of unit — the PFD response-zone list of August 7, 2025. The initial assignment is the first 4 engines, 2 ladders, the battalion chief, the medic and the rescue / squad.

      Box outline and hydrants. From the PFD box books. Check a hydrant before you rely on it.

      Addresses. The City of Philadelphia's property (OPA) list, downloaded October 14, 2026. A house number the City does not list takes the nearest listed one, and says so.

      Distances. Miles are straight-line from each company's quarters to the box — not driving distance.

      Directions. They open in your maps app (Apple Maps on an iPhone or iPad, Google Maps elsewhere), which starts from wherever you are. This page never asks for your location.
